places-el-laberinto-abrigo-del-mojao.story: A 256 km round trip from Calasparra - roughly 4 h 25 in the saddle. It goes by way of Abrigo de Zaén I, Abrigo del mojao and back through Abrigo de Zaén I. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-corsica-west-coast-d81.slogan: Corsica West Coast D81 – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-corsica-west-coast-d81.story: curated scenic road. granite coast, sea cliffs, mountains. A one-way ride of 79 km, Ajaccio to Calvi - roughly 1 h 26 in the saddle. It goes by way of Cargèse and Corsica West Coast D81. The highest point is about 850 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Corsica West Coast D81
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 6 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
